paras: Set on the sand of Playa Chiquita, Aguas Claras is an intimate, 12-room retreat that feels handcrafted rather than staged. Curated bungalows and Pavlova suites open to sea breezes and original artworks, each room furnished with locally made pieces and natural materials that reference the region's Afro-Caribbean heritage.

Days here move between the beach and the jungle: morning swims and snorkeling, afternoons in a plunge pool or at the Dalime beach club, and evenings at the Papaya restaurant or around an intimate bonfire. The small scale and attentive team mean experiences are private and easy to personalize, whether you want a guided surf session, a cacao ceremony, or simply a hammock and a book.

Aguas Claras programs center on the dual rhythm of sea and forest. Mornings might include a guided snorkeling trip or a private surf lesson, while afternoons can be spent biking coastal trails to neighboring coves or exploring jungle trails with a naturalist guide.

Cultural experiences are equally prominent: book an Afro-Caribbean music night, join a cacao ceremony, or take a hands-on cooking and cocktail class that teaches regional flavors. For slow, restorative days the property curates private yoga, breathwork sessions and beach bonfires with live acoustic music.

Standout features: Papaya restaurant serving locally inspired cuisine, Dalime beach club access, private plunge pools in selected two-bedroom bungalows, a small wellness program with therapies and yoga, daily housekeeping and optional full-board plans, complimentary beach bicycles and free Wi-Fi. The property's small size enables private guiding and tailored itineraries, with sustainable sourcing and community partnerships woven into operations.

onlyHere: Aguas Claras specializes in intimate Caribbean moments that feel impossible to recreate at larger resorts: candlelit beach bonfires with local musicians, theme nights centered on regional foodways, and small, private cacao ceremonies led by community practitioners.

The combination of artist-filled bungalows, direct Playa Chiquita access, and curated Afro-Caribbean programming results in singular evenings of live music, locally led cooking classes, and restorative wellness practices framed by ocean and jungle.

why.title: Direct Beach Access
why.body: Aguas Claras sits directly on Playa Chiquita, with immediate access to sand, surf and calm snorkeling coves for morning swims and low-key beach days.

why.title: Artful, Local Design
why.body: Rooms are individually styled with original artworks and handcrafted furnishings, creating a sense of place that blends contemporary comfort with Caribbean craft.

why.title: Intimacy and Privacy
why.body: With just twelve rooms, the property feels like a private compound: discreet service, the option for private dining, and two-bedroom bungalows that work well for families or small groups.

why.title: Wellness and Culture
why.body: A dedicated yoga shala, breathwork and meditation classes, and on-site wellness therapies pair easily with cultural programming such as cacao ceremonies and Afro-Caribbean music nights.

why.title: Eco-Conscious Practices
why.body: The retreat emphasizes sustainable operations and community engagement, from local sourcing in the Papaya kitchen to practices that reduce waste and support nearby villages.

facts.how_to_get_there: Fly into San José (SJO) or Puerto Limón, then continue by road to Playa Chiquita near Puerto Viejo de Talamanca. The property can arrange private transfers or advise on rental car routes.
facts.who_its_for: Honeymooners, families, solo travelers and eco-minded luxury seekers who want an intimate, art-filled beach retreat with wellness and Caribbean culture woven in.
facts.signature_experiences: Candlelit beach bonfires with local musicians, private cacao ceremonies, surf and snorkeling on Playa Chiquita, the Dalime beach club, and Afro-Caribbean cooking and cocktail classes.

faqs.q: What is Aguas Claras known for?
faqs.a: Aguas Claras is known for its small-scale, art-filled Caribbean retreat on Playa Chiquita, blending eco-luxury with Afro-Caribbean culture, wellness programming, and direct beach access.

faqs.q: How many rooms does Aguas Claras have?
faqs.a: The property is an intimate 12-room retreat, with a mix of Pavlova suites, one-bedroom bungalows and two-bedroom bungalows including options with private plunge pools.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit Aguas Claras?
faqs.a: Aguas Claras is open year-round. Conditions on the Caribbean coast vary seasonally, so contact the team for advice on the best months for surfing, snorkeling or calmer seas.

faqs.q: Is Aguas Claras good for families?
faqs.a: Yes. The property offers two-bedroom bungalows suitable for families, family-friendly beach activities, and private guiding that can be tailored to multi-generational needs.

faqs.q: How do you get to Aguas Claras?
faqs.a: Most guests fly into San José or Puerto Limón and then continue by road to Playa Chiquita near Puerto Viejo de Talamanca. The property can help arrange private transfers or advise on rental car routes.

faqs.q: Are meals included at the property?
faqs.a: Breakfast is included with stays, and full-board or a la carte dining is available through the Papaya restaurant and optional beach club arrangements.

faqs.q: Does Aguas Claras offer wellness and yoga?
faqs.a: Yes. The property features a yoga shala and offers yoga, meditation and breathwork classes, along with on-site wellness therapies and tailored restorative programs.
